key_insight: ASYS uses an agent-guided symbolic search process to discover interpretable PDE formulas and analytical approximations, rather than relying only on meshes, numerical tables, or black-box neural nets.
engineering_relevance: This could help computational scientists obtain compact, human-readable surrogate laws for PDE behavior, accelerating analysis, hypothesis generation, and model validation.
method: Agent translates PDE theory, public constraints, and prior search experience into testable differentiable symbolic programs.
Evolutionary search refines the symbolic form while gradient-based optimization fits continuous parameters.
Acts as prior-guided inductive bias injection instead of blind symbolic regression.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on five PDE problems spanning bounded dynamics, finite-time blow-up, and free-boundary focusing, including previously unavailable interpretable formulas.
watch_item: Performance likely depends on the quality of priors, constraint encoding, and search space design, so the method may be sensitive to implementation and problem setup.
paper_title: Agentic Symbolic Search: Characterizing PDEs Beyond Hand-crafted Expressions, Meshes, and Neural Networks
